'''Esstran Exports''' was a trading company that dealt in items from the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
Esstran Exports appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the Reputation faction for the Explorer's Packs on the Cartel Market.
